example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ সে ঘরে থাকবে না, বাইরে যাবে।
বাচ্চারা স্কুলে গেছে, আমি একা ঘরে থাকব।
example_sentences_in_english: Today he won't stay at home; he'll go out.
The children have gone to school, I'll be alone at home.
note: This expression is straightforward and commonly used in Bengali for literal presence at home, with minimal figurative extension.
